fishing: Fall-winter bite full swing. WHEN: Trout on deeper mangrove banks (freeline shrimp); redfish/snook on oyster beds & mangroves in Lemon Bay. PASSES-BEACH: Stump/Boca Grande – sheepshead, whiting, jacks, Spanish mackerel, snook; beach trout, whiting, pompano. LEMON BAY: Bigger redfish, snook stacked on oysters. NEARSHORE: Sheepshead on reefs, Spanish mackerel, cobia, triple tail. Baits: live shrimp, whitebait/pilchards, cutbait, jigs.
redtide: FWC ~11/20-27: K. brevis very low/background in SWFL (one Charlotte sample); bloom concentrations and fish kills confined to NW FL (Bay/Gulf counties).
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach Good (10 enterococci/100mL on 11/16); Englewood Beach Good.
